revocation.method: set status to revoked or disable project profile automation_policy.lark_oauth_recovery
revocation.effect: future flows fail closed to manual authorization

rollback.code: git revert the scoped implementation commit
rollback.runtime: disable the profile policy; terminate only the owned OAuth listener; verify lock and callback port are released

post_action_verification: guard action is token_valid or login_success
callback port has no owned listener
task_read_count is zero for auth-only recovery
no secret was printed or persisted outside the existing auth store

review.reason: Agent OS route classified the domain ambiguously and existing T2 fan-out was below quorum; deterministic authority and safety boundaries are recorded instead of treating model agreement as permission.
invariants: durable grant is consumed only by non-health Lark flow
task read and Lark write are outside this grant
